name: Breakfast with Santa and Mrs. Claus at Texas Roadhouse in Sanford
when_note: Saturday, December 12, seatings from 8 AM to 11 AM
cost: $15 per child ages 2 to 12, $20 adult seating, plus a small ticket service fee
ages: Children ages 2 to 12 with an adult
paras: Ladies 327 hosts Breakfast with Santa and Mrs. Claus at the Texas Roadhouse in Sanford on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 8 AM to 11 AM. The group describes a morning of breakfast, Christmas activities and a visit with Santa and Mrs. Claus.
Families pick a seating time on the Ladies 327 event page, with half hour seatings that start at 8:00, 8:30, 9:00, 9:30, 10:00 and 10:30 AM.
Child tickets for ages 2 to 12 cost $15 each and adult seating costs $20 each, with a small ticket service fee added at checkout. Ticket sales close at 9 PM on Friday, December 11.
The restaurant sits at 100 Towne Center Blvd in Sanford.
tip: Pick a seating on the Ladies 327 page by Friday night, December 11, when ticket sales close.

name: Cookies and Milk with Santa and Mrs. Claus at Dees Brothers Brewery in Sanford
cost: Free to attend, photos with Santa from $15
paras: Ladies 327 holds Cookies and Milk with Santa and Mrs. Claus at Dees Brothers Brewery in Sanford on Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 11 AM to 3 PM. The group calls the event free to attend and aimed at families making holiday memories.
Photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus are sold separately at $15 for one child, $25 for two children and $30 for three children, with a small ticket service fee added at checkout.
Photo tickets are booked by hour, with time slots at 11 AM to noon, noon to 1 PM, 1 PM to 2 PM and 2 PM to 3 PM. Photo ticket sales close at 11:50 PM on Friday, December 18.
The brewery is at 210 S. Magnolia Ave in downtown Sanford.
tip: Book a photo hour on the Ladies 327 page before Friday night, December 18.
